418	                while ($i -lt $lines.Count -and $lines[$i].Trim() -ne '') { $i++ }
419	            } else {
420	                $result += $lines[$i]
421	                $i++

423	        }

1	# aitools-lib.ps1 -- shared helpers for all aitools PowerShell scripts
2	# Dot-sourced, not executed directly.
3	#
4	# Provides: ReadConfigKey, Initialize-Logging, Log/LogOk/LogError/LogWarn/
5	# LogDetail, Invoke-AI, Write-Summary, Show-Summary, Refresh-Path,
6	# Log-WingetOutput, Repair-UvToolEnv, Remove-OrphanedPythonDirs,
7	# Normalize-JsonForComparison.
8	#
9	# Usage:
10	#   . (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path) "aitools-lib.ps1")
11	#   Initialize-Logging "script-name"
12	#
13	# Entry points (aitools.ps1, aitools-install.ps1) override log functions after
14	# sourcing for specialized logging (file-only, JSONL, etc.).
15	#
16	# Platform detection uses PS 7+ built-in $IsMacOS/$IsWindows -- no custom variables.
17	
18	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
19	# Config reader (PS 5.1 compatible)
20	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21	function ReadConfigKey {
22	    param([string]$File, [string]$Key)
23	    if (-not (Test-Path $File)) { return $null }
24	    try {
25	        $json = Get-Content $File -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json
26	        $val = $json.$Key
27	        if ($val) { return $val }
28	    } catch {
29	        # File exists but is invalid JSON -- warn so callers know the null
30	        # return means "corrupt", not "missing key"
31	        Write-Host "      WARN: could not parse $File" -ForegroundColor Yellow
32	    }
33	    return $null
34	}
35	
36	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
37	# Logging init
38	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	# Sets $script:scriptName, $script:logDir, $script:logFile; resets
40	# $script:errors, $script:warnings. Creates log directory.
41	# Usage: Initialize-Logging "setup-foo"
42	function Initialize-Logging {
43	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name)
44	    $script:scriptName = $Name
45	    if ($IsWindows -or (-not (Test-Path variable:IsMacOS))) {
46	        # Windows (PS 7+) or PS 5.1 (always Windows)
47	        $script:logDir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "aitools"
48	    } elseif ($IsMacOS) {
49	        $script:logDir = Join-Path $HOME "Library/Logs/aitools"
50	    } else {
51	        # Linux: XDG_STATE_HOME, default ~/.local/state
52	        $xdg = $env:XDG_STATE_HOME
53	        if (-not $xdg) { $xdg = Join-Path $HOME ".local/state" }
54	        $script:logDir = Join-Path $xdg "aitools"
55	    }
56	    $script:logFile = Join-Path $script:logDir "deploy.log"
57	    if (-not (Test-Path $script:logDir)) {
58	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:logDir -Force | Out-Null
59	    }
60	    $script:errors = 0
61	    $script:warnings = 0
62	}
63	
64	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
65	# Standard logging (console + log file, with [level] tag)
66	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	function Log($msg, $level = "info") {
68	    $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
69	    $line = "[$ts] [$scriptName] [$level] $msg"
70	    $resolvedLog = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($logFile)
71	    [IO.File]::AppendAllText($resolvedLog, "$line`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
72	    switch ($level) {
73	        "error" { Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Red }
74	        "warn"  { Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor Yellow }
75	        default { Write-Host $line }
76	    }
77	}
78	function LogOk($msg)    { Log $msg "ok" }
79	function LogError($msg) { Log $msg "error"; $script:errors++ }
80	function LogWarn($msg)  { Log $msg "warn"; $script:warnings++ }
81	function LogDetail($msg) {
82	    $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
83	    $resolvedLog = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($logFile)
84	    [IO.File]::AppendAllText($resolvedLog, "[$ts] [$scriptName] [detail] $msg`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
85	}

87	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
88	# Agentic AI invocation -- generalized wrapper for claude/agent CLI
89	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
90	# Purpose: Standardized AI CLI invocation with speed/permission tiers,
91	#   validation callbacks, automatic retry, and telemetry logging.
92	# Inputs: Prompt (pipeline), Speed, Permissions, ValidateFn, MaxRetries
93	# Expected output: AI-generated text string, or $null on failure.
94	# Validation: Caller-provided ValidateFn (function name); receives output as
95	#   positional arg, must return $true/$false and set $script:AIRejectReason.
96	# Known limitations: Agent CLI has no --model flag; speed is hint-only via
97	#   prompt prefix. Retry prepends rejection reason but may not fix structural
98	#   issues (e.g., model always wrapping in code fences).
99	$script:AIRejectReason = ""
100	
101	function Invoke-AI {
102	    param(
103	        [Parameter(Mandatory, ValueFromPipeline)][string]$Prompt,
104	        [ValidateSet("fast","balanced","quality")][string]$Speed = "balanced",
105	        [ValidateSet("none","readonly","full","dangerous")][string]$Permissions = "none",
106	        [string]$ValidateFn = "",
107	        [int]$MaxRetries = 0
108	    )
109	
110	    $script:AIRejectReason = ""
111	
112	    # Detect backend
113	    # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback chain
114	    $cliCmd = $null
115	    if (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
116	        $cliCmd = "claude"
117	    } elseif (Get-Command agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
118	        $cliCmd = "agent"
119	    }
120	
121	    if (-not $cliCmd) {
122	        $script:AIRejectReason = "No AI CLI available (claude or agent)"
123	        Log "AI invocation: no CLI available (claude or agent)" "error"
124	        return $null
125	    }
126	
127	    # Build CLI flags
128	    $flags = @()
129	
130	    if ($cliCmd -eq "claude") {
131	        $flags += "-p", "--no-session-persistence"
132	        # Speed mapping (claude CLI: explicit model + effort)
133	        switch ($Speed) {
134	            "fast"     { $flags += "--model", "haiku", "--effort", "low" }
135	            "balanced" { $flags += "--model", "sonnet" }
136	            "quality"  { $flags += "--model", "opus", "--effort", "high" }
137	        }
138	        # Permission mapping
139	        switch ($Permissions) {
140	            "none"      { $flags += "--allowedTools", "" }
141	            "readonly"  { $flags += "--allowedTools", "Read Glob Grep" }
142	            "full"      { } # default -- no restriction
143	            "dangerous" { $flags += "--dangerously-skip-permissions" }
144	        }
145	        # System prompt hints for speed tiers
146	        switch ($Speed) {
147	            "fast"    { $flags += "--append-system-prompt", "Be concise and direct." }
148	            "quality" { $flags += "--append-system-prompt", "Take your time. Be thorough." }
149	        }
150	    } else {
151	        # Agent CLI -- no --model flag; speed via prompt prefix only
152	        $flags += "-p", "--trust"
153	        # Permission mapping
154	        switch ($Permissions) {
155	            "none"      { $flags += "--mode", "ask" }
156	            "readonly"  { $flags += "--mode", "plan" }
157	            "full"      { } # default
158	            "dangerous" { $flags += "--force" }
159	        }
160	    }
161	
162	    # Speed prefix for agent CLI (no model flag available)
163	    $speedPrefix = ""
164	    if ($cliCmd -eq "agent") {
165	        switch ($Speed) {
166	            "fast"    { $speedPrefix = "Be concise and direct. Prioritize speed.`n`n" }
167	            "quality" { $speedPrefix = "Take your time. Be thorough and precise.`n`n" }
168	        }
169	    }
170	
171	    # Retry loop
172	    $currentPrompt = $Prompt
173	    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le ($MaxRetries + 1); $attempt++) {
174	        Log "AI invocation: speed=$Speed backend=$cliCmd attempt=$attempt"
175	
176	        $fullPrompt = "${speedPrefix}${currentPrompt}"
177	
178	        $output = $null
179	        try {
180	            $output = $fullPrompt | & $cliCmd @flags 2>&1
181	            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $output = $null }
182	        } catch {
183	            # CLI invocation failed (e.g., binary not found despite Get-Command)
184	            Log "AI invocation error: $_" "warn"
185	            $output = $null
186	        }
187	
188	        # Normalize array output to string
189	        if ($output -is [array]) { $output = $output -join "`n" }
190	
191	        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($output)) {
192	            $script:AIRejectReason = "Empty output from $cliCmd"
193	            Log "AI invocation: speed=$Speed backend=$cliCmd attempt=$attempt result=empty" "warn"
194	            if ($attempt -le $MaxRetries) {
195	                $currentPrompt = "Your previous output was empty. Try again.`n`n$Prompt"
196	                continue
197	            }
198	            return $null
199	        }
200	
201	        # Validate if function provided
202	        if ($ValidateFn) {
203	            $valid = & $ValidateFn $output
204	            if (-not $valid) {
205	                if (-not $script:AIRejectReason) { $script:AIRejectReason = "Validation failed" }
206	                Log "AI invocation: speed=$Speed backend=$cliCmd attempt=$attempt result=rejected reason=$($script:AIRejectReason)" "warn"
207	                foreach ($rejLine in ($output -split "`n")) {
208	                    LogDetail "ai-rejected: $rejLine"
209	                }
210	                if ($attempt -le $MaxRetries) {
211	                    $currentPrompt = "Your previous output was rejected: $($script:AIRejectReason). Try again.`n`n$Prompt"
212	                    continue
213	                }
214	                Log "AI invocation: speed=$Speed backend=$cliCmd exhausted after $attempt attempts" "warn"
215	                return $null
216	            }
217	        }
218	
219	        # Success
220	        Log "AI invocation: speed=$Speed backend=$cliCmd attempt=$attempt result=accepted"
221	        return $output
222	    }
223	
224	    return $null
225	}

227	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
228	# Summary writer (3-arg: category, tool, detail)

230	function Write-Summary($cat, $tool, $detail) {
231	    if ($env:AITOOLS_SUMMARY_FILE) {
232	        # Auto-promote OK to WARN when warnings have been logged
233	        if ($cat -eq "OK" -and $script:warnings -gt 0) {
234	            $cat = "WARN"

236	        $resolvedSummary = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($env:AITOOLS_SUMMARY_FILE)
237	        [IO.File]::AppendAllText($resolvedSummary, "${cat}|${tool}|${detail}`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
238	    }
239	}

241	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
242	# Backup a file before overwriting. Keeps at most $MaxBackups copies.
243	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
244	function Backup-File {
245	    param([string]$FilePath, [int]$MaxBackups = 20)
246	    if (-not (Test-Path $FilePath)) { return }
247	    $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHHmmssZ")
248	    $backupPath = "${FilePath}.bak.${ts}"
249	    Copy-Item -Path $FilePath -Destination $backupPath
250	    # Prune oldest beyond limit
251	    $backups = Get-ChildItem -Path "${FilePath}.bak.*" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
252	    if ($backups.Count -gt $MaxBackups) {
253	        $backups | Select-Object -Skip $MaxBackups | Remove-Item -Force
254	    }
255	    Log "Backed up $FilePath"
256	}
257	
258	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
259	# Backup a directory before modifying managed files. Keeps at most $MaxBackups copies.
260	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
261	function Backup-Dir {
262	    param([string]$DirPath, [int]$MaxBackups = 5)
263	    if (-not (Test-Path $DirPath)) { return }
264	    $mdFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $DirPath -Filter "*.md" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
265	    if (-not $mdFiles -or $mdFiles.Count -eq 0) { return }
266	    $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHHmmssZ")
267	    $backupPath = "${DirPath}.bak.${ts}"
268	    try {
269	        Copy-Item -Path $DirPath -Destination $backupPath -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop
270	    } catch {
271	        LogWarn "Could not back up $DirPath -- proceeding without backup: $_"
272	        return
273	    }
274	    $parentDir = Split-Path $DirPath -Parent
275	    $dirName = Split-Path $DirPath -Leaf
276	    $backups = Get-ChildItem -Path $parentDir -Directory -Filter "${dirName}.bak.*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
277	        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
278	    if ($backups -and $backups.Count -gt $MaxBackups) {
279	        $backups | Select-Object -Skip $MaxBackups | ForEach-Object {
280	            Remove-Item $_.FullName -Recurse -Force
281	            Log "Pruned old backup: $($_.FullName)"
282	        }
283	    }
284	    Log "Backed up $DirPath ($($mdFiles.Count) managed files)"
285	}
286	
287	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
288	# Deploy state tracking: manifest + shadow copies for auto-deploy detection.
289	# Tracks what was last deployed to each managed file. When the local file
290	# matches the last-deployed hash, content changes are auto-deployed without
291	# prompting (user didn't edit). Shadows provide the common ancestor for diff3.
292	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
293	$script:DeployManifest = $null
294	$script:DeployStateDir = if ($IsWindows) { "$env:USERPROFILE\.aitools\deploy-state" } else { "$HOME/.aitools/deploy-state" }
295	
296	function Get-ContentHash {
297	    param([string]$Content)
298	    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Content)
299	    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
300	    try {
301	        $hash = $sha.ComputeHash($bytes)
302	        return [BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-'
303	    } finally {
304	        $sha.Dispose()
305	    }
306	}
307	
308	function Initialize-DeployState {
309	    $manifestPath = Join-Path $script:DeployStateDir "manifest.json"
310	    if (Test-Path $manifestPath) {
311	        try {
312	            $raw = Get-Content $manifestPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
313	            $script:DeployManifest = ($raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
314	            if (-not $script:DeployManifest.files) {
315	                $script:DeployManifest | Add-Member -NotePropertyName files -NotePropertyValue @{} -Force
316	            }
317	        } catch {
318	            LogWarn "Corrupt deploy manifest, resetting: $_"
319	            $script:DeployManifest = [PSCustomObject]@{ version = 1; files = @{} }
320	        }
321	    } else {
322	        $script:DeployManifest = [PSCustomObject]@{ version = 1; files = @{} }
323	    }
324	}
325	
326	function Get-DeployStateKey {
327	    param([string]$FilePath)
328	    $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($FilePath)
329	    $homeDir = if ($IsWindows) { $env:USERPROFILE } else { $env:HOME }
330	    if ($resolved.StartsWith($homeDir, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
331	        return $resolved.Substring($homeDir.Length).Replace('\', '/').TrimStart('/')
332	    }
333	    return $resolved.Replace('\', '/')
334	}
335	
336	function Get-DeployState {
337	    param([string]$FilePath)
338	    if (-not $script:DeployManifest) { Initialize-DeployState }
339	    $key = Get-DeployStateKey $FilePath
340	    $files = $script:DeployManifest.files
341	    if ($files -is [hashtable]) {
342	        if ($files.ContainsKey($key)) { return $files[$key] }
343	    } else {
344	        $val = $files.$key
345	        if ($val) { return $val }
346	    }
347	    return $null
348	}
349	
350	function Update-DeployState {
351	    param([string]$FilePath, [string]$Content)
352	    if (-not $script:DeployManifest) { Initialize-DeployState }
353	    $key = Get-DeployStateKey $FilePath
354	    $hash = Get-ContentHash $Content
355	    $ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
356	
357	    $entry = [PSCustomObject]@{ hash = $hash; deployedAt = $ts }
358	    $files = $script:DeployManifest.files
359	    if ($files -is [hashtable]) {
360	        $files[$key] = $entry
361	    } else {
362	        $ht = @{}
363	        $files.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $ht[$_.Name] = $_.Value }
364	        $ht[$key] = $entry
365	        $script:DeployManifest | Add-Member -NotePropertyName files -NotePropertyValue $ht -Force
366	    }
367	
368	    $manifestDir = $script:DeployStateDir
369	    if (-not (Test-Path $manifestDir)) {
370	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $manifestDir -Force | Out-Null
371	    }
372	    $manifestPath = Join-Path $manifestDir "manifest.json"
373	    $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($manifestPath)
374	    $json = $script:DeployManifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
375	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolved, $json, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
376	
377	    $shadowPath = Join-Path $manifestDir "shadows" $key
378	    $shadowDir = Split-Path $shadowPath -Parent
379	    if (-not (Test-Path $shadowDir)) {
380	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $shadowDir -Force | Out-Null
381	    }
382	    $resolvedShadow = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($shadowPath)
383	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolvedShadow, $Content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
384	}
385	
386	function Get-DeployShadow {
387	    param([string]$FilePath)
388	    $key = Get-DeployStateKey $FilePath
389	    $shadowPath = Join-Path $script:DeployStateDir "shadows" $key
390	    if (Test-Path $shadowPath) {
391	        try {
392	            return Get-Content $shadowPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
393	        } catch {
394	            return $null
395	        }
396	    }
397	    return $null
398	}
399	
400	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
401	# Non-agentic 3-way merge using shadow as common ancestor.
402	# Backend: git merge-file (guaranteed prerequisite -- no discovery needed).
403	# Returns merged content string on clean merge, $null on conflicts/error.
404	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
405	function Try-AutoMerge {
406	    param(
407	        [string]$LocalContent,
408	        [string]$AncestorContent,
409	        [string]$SourceContent
410	    )
411	    $tmpLocal = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
412	    $tmpAncestor = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
413	    $tmpSource = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
414	    try {
415	        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmpLocal, $LocalContent)
416	        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmpAncestor, $AncestorContent)
417	        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmpSource, $SourceContent)
418	
419	        # In-place merge: modifies $tmpLocal with merged result.
420	        # Avoids -p (stdout) which decodes UTF-8 through [Console]::OutputEncoding
421	        # (OEM codepage on Windows), mangling non-ASCII characters.
422	        git merge-file $tmpLocal $tmpAncestor $tmpSource 2>$null
423	        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
424	            return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($tmpLocal, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
425	        }
426	        return $null
427	    } catch {
428	        return $null
429	    } finally {
430	        Remove-Item $tmpLocal, $tmpAncestor, $tmpSource -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
431	        # ErrorAction exempt: temp file cleanup; files may already be gone
432	    }
433	}

435	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
436	# Merge file description lookup
437	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
438	# Purpose: Returns a human-readable description of a managed file for AI merge
439	#   prompts, providing context about the file's role in the config system.
440	function Get-MergeFileDescription {
441	    param([string]$FilePath)
442	    $name = Split-Path $FilePath -Leaf
443	    switch -Wildcard ($name) {
444	        "CLAUDE.md" { return "User-scope CLAUDE.md -- personal preferences and instructions for Claude Code" }
445	        "*.md"      { return "Configuration rule: $name" }
446	        "*.json"    { return "JSON config: $name" }
447	        default     { return "Managed file: $name" }
448	    }
449	}
450	
451	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
452	# AI merge prompt builder (initial merge)
453	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
454	# Purpose: Builds a structured merge prompt following the Role/Context/Task/
455	#   Constraints/Format pattern for merging managed configuration files.
456	# Inputs: FilePath, SourceContent, LocalContent, DiffOutput
457	# Expected output: Complete prompt string suitable for Invoke-AI.
458	# Validation: Test-AiMergeOutput (5 checks: conversational, fences,
459	#   refusal, truncation, header preservation)
460	# Known limitations: Very large files may hit model context limits. Files with
461	#   no markdown headers rely on Check 4 (length) for rewrite detection.
462	function Get-AiMergePrompt {
463	    param(
464	        [string]$FilePath,
465	        [string]$SourceContent,
466	        [string]$LocalContent,
467	        [string]$DiffOutput
468	    )
469	    $fileDesc = Get-MergeFileDescription $FilePath
470	    return @"
471	You are merging a managed configuration file during automated deployment.
472	
473	## What you are merging
474	$fileDesc
475	
476	## Where changes come from
477	SOURCE: The canonical template, synced across machines -- the updated version being deployed
478	LOCAL: The user's current file on this machine, with their customizations
479	
480	## What is happening
481	Updated configuration is being deployed. Source has changed and needs to be
482	incorporated without losing local customizations.
483	
484	## Differences (unified diff: local vs source)
485	$DiffOutput
486	
487	## Full local file (start from this)
488	<LOCAL>
489	$LocalContent
490	</LOCAL>
491	
492	## Rules
493	1. Start with LOCAL as your base -- preserve all user customizations
494	2. Apply ONLY the changes shown in the diff
495	3. If a change conflicts with a local customization (contradicts its intent), keep local
496	4. If a change adds new content not in LOCAL, add it in the appropriate location
497	5. If a change updates content the user hasn't customized, apply it
498	6. CRITICAL: Do NOT wrap your output in markdown code fences (``````). Output raw file content ONLY
499	7. No commentary, no explanation, no preamble -- just the merged file content
500	"@
501	}
502	
503	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
504	# AI merge prompt builder (refinement)
505	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
506	# Purpose: Builds a refinement prompt for iterating on a previous merge result
507	#   based on user feedback.
508	# Inputs: SourceContent, LocalContent, CurrentMerge, Feedback
509	# Validation: Same as initial merge (Test-AiMergeOutput).
510	function Get-AiMergeRefinePrompt {
511	    param(
512	        [string]$SourceContent,
513	        [string]$LocalContent,
514	        [string]$CurrentMerge,
515	        [string]$Feedback
516	    )
517	    return @"
518	You are refining a merged configuration file based on user feedback.
519	
520	## Context
521	A previous merge produced CURRENT_MERGE from SOURCE + LOCAL. The user wants changes.
522	
523	## SOURCE (original template)
524	<SOURCE>
525	$SourceContent
526	</SOURCE>
527	
528	## LOCAL (original user file)
529	<LOCAL>
530	$LocalContent
531	</LOCAL>
532	
533	## CURRENT MERGE (previous result)
534	<CURRENT_MERGE>
535	$CurrentMerge
536	</CURRENT_MERGE>
537	
538	## User Feedback
539	$Feedback
540	
541	## Rules
542	- Apply the user's feedback to CURRENT_MERGE
543	- Keep all content from CURRENT_MERGE not affected by the feedback
544	- Output the revised merged file content ONLY -- no preamble, no explanation, no markdown fences
545	"@
546	}
547	
548	# Merge validation wrapper for Invoke-AI -- captures source/local context
549	# via script-level variables set by Invoke-AiMerge before calling Invoke-AI.
550	$script:_mergeValidateSource = ""
551	$script:_mergeValidateLocal = ""
552	function _MergeValidateWrapper {
553	    param([string]$Output)
554	    $result = Test-AiMergeOutput -Output $Output -SourceContent $script:_mergeValidateSource -LocalContent $script:_mergeValidateLocal
555	    $script:AIRejectReason = $script:MergeRejectReason
556	    return $result
557	}
558	
559	$script:MergeRejectReason = ""
560	
561	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
562	# Validate AI merge output before accepting it.
563	# Returns $true if valid, $false if invalid. Sets $script:MergeRejectReason.
564	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
565	function Test-AiMergeOutput {
566	    param(
567	        [string]$Output,
568	        [string]$SourceContent,
569	        [string]$LocalContent
570	    )
571	    $script:MergeRejectReason = ""
572	
573	    # Check 1: conversational patterns (first non-empty line)
574	    $firstLine = ($Output -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -First 1)
575	    if ($firstLine -and $firstLine -match '(?i)^(I |Here|Sure|Certainly|Let me)') {
576	        $truncated = $firstLine.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(60, $firstLine.Length))
577	        $script:MergeRejectReason = "AI responded conversationally instead of producing merged content"
578	        return $false
579	    }
580	
581	    # Check 2: markdown code fences
582	    if ($Output -match '(?m)^```') {
583	        $script:MergeRejectReason = "AI wrapped output in code fences -- need raw content"
584	        return $false
585	    }
586	
587	    # Check 3: conversational refusal patterns (not bare keywords -- content may
588	    # legitimately contain "permission", "access", etc.)
589	    if ($Output -match '(?i)(I don''t have permission|I cannot access|I''m not authorized|I need (your )?approval|permission denied|access denied|I''m unable to|I can''t (read|write|access|open|modify))') {
590	        $script:MergeRejectReason = "AI indicated it couldn't perform the merge"
591	        return $false
592	    }
593	
594	    # Check 4: minimum length (output >= 50% of shorter input when shorter > 40 chars)
595	    $outLen = $Output.Length
596	    $minInputLen = [Math]::Min($SourceContent.Length, $LocalContent.Length)
597	    $threshold = [Math]::Floor($minInputLen / 2)
598	    if ($minInputLen -gt 40 -and $outLen -lt $threshold) {
599	        $script:MergeRejectReason = "Output too short ($outLen chars, expected ${threshold}+) -- likely truncated"
600	        return $false
601	    }
602	
603	    # Check 5: header preservation -- deduplicated headers from source+local must
604	    # be >=60% preserved in output. Files with 0 headers pass (Check 4 handles truncation).
605	    $allHeaders = @()
606	    foreach ($line in (($SourceContent + "`n" + $LocalContent) -split "`n")) {
607	        if ($line -match '^#{1,6} ') { $allHeaders += $line }
608	    }
609	    $combinedHeaders = @($allHeaders | Sort-Object -Unique)
610	    $total = $combinedHeaders.Count
611	    if ($total -gt 0) {
612	        $preserved = 0
613	        foreach ($header in $combinedHeaders) {
614	            if ($Output.Contains($header)) { $preserved++ }
615	        }
616	        $threshold = [Math]::Ceiling($total * 60 / 100)
617	        if ($threshold -lt 1) { $threshold = 1 }
618	        if ($preserved -lt $threshold) {
619	            $script:MergeRejectReason = "Rewrote too much ($preserved/$total section headers preserved, need 60%+)"
620	            return $false
621	        }
622	    }
623	
624	    return $true
625	}
626	
627	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
628	# Spinner for AI operations (visual progress indicator)
629	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
630	$script:_aiSpinnerJob = $null
631	
632	function Start-AiSpinner {
633	    param([string]$Message = "working...")
634	    $script:_aiSpinnerJob = Start-Job -ScriptBlock {
635	        param($msg)
636	        $chars = '/-\|'
637	        $i = 0
638	        while ($true) {
639	            $c = $chars[$i % 4]
640	            [Console]::Write("`r  $c $msg")
641	            $i++
642	            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
643	        }
644	    } -ArgumentList $Message
645	}
646	
647	function Stop-AiSpinner {
648	    if ($script:_aiSpinnerJob) {
649	        Stop-Job $script:_aiSpinnerJob -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
650	        Remove-Job $script:_aiSpinnerJob -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
651	        # ErrorAction exempt: spinner cleanup; job may already be stopped
652	        $script:_aiSpinnerJob = $null
653	        [Console]::Write("`r  `e[K")  # clear spinner line
654	    }
655	}
656	
657	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
658	# Agentic merge via Invoke-AI with refinement loop.
659	# Uses structured prompts from Get-AiMergePrompt / Get-AiMergeRefinePrompt.
660	# Returns "merge" (sets $script:MergedContent) or "overwrite"/"skip".
661	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
662	function Invoke-AiMerge {
663	    param(
664	        [string]$FilePath,
665	        [string]$SourceContent,
666	        [string]$LocalContent,
667	        [string]$DiffOutput = ""
668	    )
669	
670	    # Detect backend for transparency display
671	    # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback
672	    $aiBackend = "unknown"
673	    if (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
674	        $aiBackend = "claude"
675	    } elseif (Get-Command agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
676	        $aiBackend = "agent"
677	    }
678	    $displayName = Split-Path -Leaf $FilePath
679	    [Console]::WriteLine("  >> AI merge: $aiBackend (balanced) -- merging $displayName...")
680	
681	    # Set validation context for _MergeValidateWrapper
682	    $script:_mergeValidateSource = $SourceContent
683	    $script:_mergeValidateLocal = $LocalContent
684	
685	    $currentMerge = ""
686	    $iteration = 0
687	
688	    while ($true) {
689	        $iteration++
690	
691	        if (-not $currentMerge) {
692	            $promptText = Get-AiMergePrompt -FilePath $FilePath -SourceContent $SourceContent `
693	                -LocalContent $LocalContent -DiffOutput $DiffOutput
694	        } else {
695	            [Console]::Write("  refinement feedback: ")
696	            $feedback = [Console]::ReadLine()
697	            $promptText = Get-AiMergeRefinePrompt -SourceContent $SourceContent `
698	                -LocalContent $LocalContent -CurrentMerge $currentMerge -Feedback $feedback
699	        }
700	
701	        Start-AiSpinner "merging $displayName (attempt $iteration)..."
702	        $merged = $promptText | Invoke-AI -Speed "balanced" -Permissions "none" `
703	            -ValidateFn "_MergeValidateWrapper" -MaxRetries 1
704	        Stop-AiSpinner
705	
706	        # Defense-in-depth: strip leading/trailing code fences if AI ignored instructions
707	        if ($merged) {
708	            $merged = $merged -replace '(?s)\A```[^\n]*\n', '' -replace '\n```\s*\z', ''
709	        }
710	
711	        if (-not $merged) {
712	            $reason = if ($script:AIRejectReason) { $script:AIRejectReason } else { "unknown error" }
713	            [Console]::WriteLine("  >> AI merge failed (iteration $iteration): $reason")
714	            LogError "AI merge failed (iteration $iteration): $reason"
715	            [Console]::Write("  fallback [o]verwrite / [s]kip: ")
716	            $fb = [Console]::ReadLine()
717	            if ($fb.ToLower() -eq "s") { return "skip" }
718	            return "overwrite"
719	        }
720	
721	        # Show merge preview
722	        [Console]::WriteLine("")
723	        [Console]::WriteLine("  --- merged result preview (first 30 lines) ---")
724	        $mergedLines = $merged -split "`n"
725	        $previewCount = [Math]::Min(30, $mergedLines.Count)
726	        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $previewCount; $i++) {
727	            [Console]::WriteLine("  | $($mergedLines[$i])")
728	        }
729	        if ($mergedLines.Count -gt 30) {
730	            [Console]::WriteLine("  | ... ($($mergedLines.Count - 30) more lines)")
731	        }
732	        [Console]::WriteLine("")
733	        [Console]::Write("  [y]es accept / [r]efine / [n]o reject: ")
734	        $accept = [Console]::ReadLine()
735	        switch ($accept.ToLower()) {
736	            "y" {
737	                $script:MergedContent = $merged
738	                [Console]::WriteLine("  >> merged: AI-merged content accepted (iteration $iteration)")
739	                return "merge"
740	            }
741	            "r" {
742	                $currentMerge = $merged
743	                [Console]::WriteLine("  >> refining merge (iteration $iteration)...")
744	                # continue loop
745	            }
746	            default {
747	                [Console]::WriteLine("  >> merge rejected, falling back to overwrite")
748	                return "overwrite"
749	            }
750	        }
751	    }
752	}
753	
754	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
755	# Prompt user before overwriting a managed file with different content.
756	# Shows diff, attempts diff3 auto-merge, offers interactive options.
757	#
758	# Returns: "overwrite", "adopt", "merge", or "skip"
759	# Exits with code 2 on abort.
760	# Non-interactive / -Force: returns "overwrite".
761	# When returning "merge", sets $script:MergedContent with the merged result.
762	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
763	$script:MergedContent = $null
764	function Prompt-DiffReview {
765	    param(
766	        [string]$FilePath,
767	        [string]$NewContent,
768	        [string]$CurrentContent = "",
769	        [string]$AncestorContent = "",
770	        [string]$AdoptLabel = ""
771	    )
772	
773	    $script:MergedContent = $null
774	
775	    # -Force or AITOOLS_FORCE: auto-overwrite
776	    if ($env:AITOOLS_FORCE -eq "1" -or $Force) {
777	        LogWarn "Diff in $FilePath -- overwriting (-Force)"
778	        return "overwrite"
779	    }
780	
781	    # Non-interactive: auto-overwrite
782	    if (-not [Environment]::UserInteractive) {
783	        LogWarn "Diff in $FilePath -- overwriting (non-interactive)"
784	        return "overwrite"
785	    }
786	
787	    # Read current file if not provided
788	    if (-not $CurrentContent) {
789	        try {
790	            $CurrentContent = Get-Content $FilePath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
791	        } catch {
792	            LogWarn "Cannot read $FilePath for diff: $_"
793	            return "overwrite"
794	        }
795	    }
796	
797	    # Context header
798	    [Console]::WriteLine("")
799	    [Console]::WriteLine("[REVIEW] $FilePath differs from source.")
800	    [Console]::WriteLine("  source = template (would deploy)")
801	    [Console]::WriteLine("  local  = current file on disk")
802	    [Console]::WriteLine("")
803	
804	    # Generate line-level diff
805	    $srcLines = @($NewContent -split "`n")
806	    $curLines = @($CurrentContent -split "`n")
807	    $diffs = Compare-Object $srcLines $curLines
808	    $diffCount = 0
809	    $diffOutput = ""
810	    if ($diffs) {
811	        $diffCount = @($diffs).Count
812	        # Build diff text for AI merge prompt
813	        $diffLines = @()
814	        foreach ($d in $diffs) {
815	            $prefix = if ($d.SideIndicator -eq "=>") { "+ " } else { "- " }
816	            $diffLines += "${prefix}$($d.InputObject)"
817	        }
818	        $diffOutput = $diffLines -join "`n"
819	    }
820	
821	    if ($diffCount -eq 0) {
822	        [Console]::WriteLine("  (whitespace-only differences)")
823	    } elseif ($diffCount -le 40) {
824	        foreach ($d in $diffs) {
825	            $indicator = if ($d.SideIndicator -eq "=>") { "+ local  " } else { "- source " }
826	            [Console]::WriteLine("  $indicator$($d.InputObject)")
827	        }
828	    } else {
829	        $shown = 0
830	        foreach ($d in $diffs) {
831	            if ($shown -ge 30) { break }
832	            $indicator = if ($d.SideIndicator -eq "=>") { "+ local  " } else { "- source " }
833	            [Console]::WriteLine("  $indicator$($d.InputObject)")
834	            $shown++
835	        }
836	        [Console]::WriteLine("  ... ($($diffCount - 30) more lines -- see deploy log)")
837	    }
838	
839	    # Attempt automatic merge if ancestor available
840	    if ($AncestorContent) {
841	        [Console]::WriteLine("")
842	        [Console]::WriteLine("  Attempting automatic merge...")
843	        $autoMerged = Try-AutoMerge -LocalContent $CurrentContent `
844	            -AncestorContent $AncestorContent -SourceContent $NewContent
845	        if ($autoMerged) {
846	            [Console]::WriteLine("  Clean merge -- no conflicts.")
847	            [Console]::WriteLine("")
848	            $mergedLines = $autoMerged -split "`n"
849	            $previewCount = [Math]::Min(30, $mergedLines.Count)
850	            [Console]::WriteLine("  --- merged result preview (first $previewCount lines) ---")
851	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $previewCount; $i++) {
852	                [Console]::WriteLine("  | $($mergedLines[$i])")

942	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
943	# Deploy a managed file with diff review and deploy state tracking.
944	# Uses manifest to auto-deploy when user hasn't edited the local file.
945	# Falls back to interactive review with merge options when both sides differ.
946	#
947	# Returns: "created", "updated", "verified", "accept & adopt", or "skipped"
948	# Exits with code 2 on abort.
949	# On "accept & adopt"/"skipped": does NOT write the file.
950	# On "created"/"updated": writes content to dest + updates deploy state.
951	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
952	function Deploy-ManagedFile {
953	    param(
954	        [string]$Content,
955	        [string]$DestPath,
956	        [string]$ToolName,
957	        [string]$ItemName,
958	        [string]$AdoptLabel = ""
959	    )
960	
961	    # Normalize trailing whitespace for consistent comparison.
962	    # Prevents round-trip diff noise (deploy -> adopt strips trailing blanks -> deploy sees diff).
963	    $Content = $Content -replace '[\r\n]+$', "`n"
964	
965	    # Dry run: report what would happen without writing
966	    if ($DryRun) {
967	        if (Test-Path $DestPath) {
968	            try {
969	                $existing = Get-Content $DestPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
970	            } catch {
971	                $existing = ""
972	            }
973	            if ($existing) { $existing = $existing -replace '[\r\n]+$', "`n" }
974	            if ($existing -eq $Content) {
975	                Log "[DRY RUN] Unchanged: $ItemName"
976	            } else {
977	                Log "[DRY RUN] Would update: $ItemName -> $DestPath"
978	            }
979	        } else {
980	            Log "[DRY RUN] Would create: $ItemName -> $DestPath"
981	        }
982	        return "verified"
983	    }
984	
985	    $destDir = Split-Path -Parent $DestPath
986	    if (-not (Test-Path $destDir)) {
987	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null
988	    }
989	
990	    if (Test-Path $DestPath) {
991	        try {
992	            $existing = Get-Content $DestPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop
993	        } catch {
994	            LogWarn "Cannot read $DestPath for comparison: $_"
995	            $existing = ""
996	        }
997	        if ($existing) { $existing = $existing -replace '[\r\n]+$', "`n" }
998	        if ($existing -eq $Content) {
999	            # Content identical — update deploy state (bootstraps manifest)
1000	            Update-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath -Content $Content
1001	            return "verified"
1002	        }
1003	
1004	        # Content differs — check deploy state for auto-deploy eligibility
1005	        $state = Get-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath
1006	        if ($state -and $state.hash) {
1007	            $existingHash = Get-ContentHash $existing
1008	            if ($existingHash -eq $state.hash) {
1009	                # User didn't edit since last deploy → auto-deploy silently
1010	                Backup-File -FilePath $DestPath
1011	                $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($DestPath)
1012	                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolved, $Content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
1013	                Update-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath -Content $Content
1014	                Log "Auto-deployed: $ItemName (no local edits detected)"
1015	                return "updated"
1016	            }
1017	        }
1018	
1019	        # User edited AND source changed — backup + interactive review
1020	        Backup-File -FilePath $DestPath
1021	        $ancestorContent = Get-DeployShadow -FilePath $DestPath
1022	        # Bootstrap: seed shadow from current deployed content if empty
1023	        if (-not $ancestorContent) {
1024	            Log "Bootstrapping deploy shadow from existing: $DestPath"
1025	            $ancestorContent = $existing
1026	        }
1027	        $result = Prompt-DiffReview -FilePath $DestPath -NewContent $Content `
1028	            -CurrentContent $existing -AncestorContent $ancestorContent `
1029	            -AdoptLabel $AdoptLabel
1030	        switch ($result) {
1031	            "adopt" { return "accept & adopt" }
1032	            "skip" {
1033	                LogWarn "Skipped: $ItemName"
1034	                return "skipped"
1035	            }
1036	            "merge-adopt" {
1037	                $Content = $script:MergedContent
1038	                $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($DestPath)
1039	                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolved, $Content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
1040	                Update-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath -Content $Content
1041	                LogOk "Updated (merge-adopt): $ItemName"
1042	                return "accept & adopt"
1043	            }
1044	            "merge" {
1045	                $Content = $script:MergedContent
1046	            }
1047	        }
1048	        # overwrite or merge: write content to dest
1049	        $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($DestPath)
1050	        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolved, $Content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
1051	        Update-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath -Content $Content
1052	        LogOk "Updated: $ItemName -> $DestPath"
1053	        return "updated"
1054	    } else {
1055	        # New file — create
1056	        $resolved = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($DestPath)
1057	        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($resolved, $Content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
1058	        Update-DeployState -FilePath $DestPath -Content $Content
1059	        LogOk "Created: $ItemName -> $DestPath"
1060	        return "created"
1061	    }
1062	}

1064	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1065	# Deploy tracker: centralizes outcome counting and summary writing for
1066	# loops that deploy multiple managed files (rules, skills, hooks).
1067	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1068	
1069	$script:dtAdded = 0; $script:dtUpdated = 0; $script:dtVerified = 0
1070	$script:dtAccepted = 0; $script:dtSkipped = 0; $script:dtPreserved = 0
1071	$script:deployTrackerText = ""
1072	
1073	function Initialize-DeployTracker {
1074	    $script:dtAdded = 0; $script:dtUpdated = 0; $script:dtVerified = 0
1075	    $script:dtAccepted = 0; $script:dtSkipped = 0; $script:dtPreserved = 0
1076	    $script:deployTrackerText = ""
1077	}
1078	
1079	# Record a single file outcome. Increments counter and writes DETAIL summary.
1080	function Record-DeployOutcome {
1081	    param([string]$Outcome, [string]$ToolName, [string]$ItemName)
1082	    switch ($Outcome) {
1083	        { $_ -eq "added" -or $_ -eq "created" } { $script:dtAdded++;     Write-Summary "DETAIL" $ToolName "added: $ItemName" }
1084	        "updated"   { $script:dtUpdated++;   Write-Summary "DETAIL" $ToolName "updated: $ItemName" }
1085	        "accept & adopt" { $script:dtAccepted++;  Write-Summary "DETAIL" $ToolName "accept & adopt: $ItemName" }
1086	        "skipped"   { $script:dtSkipped++;   Write-Summary "DETAIL" $ToolName "skipped: $ItemName" }
1087	        "verified"  { $script:dtVerified++ }
1088	        "preserved" { $script:dtPreserved++ }
1089	    }
1090	}
1091	
1092	# Write aggregate summary for a deploy loop. Uses non-zero counts.
1093	function Write-DeployTrackerSummary {
1094	    param([string]$ToolName)
1095	    $parts = @()
1096	    if ($script:dtAdded -gt 0)     { $parts += "$($script:dtAdded) added" }
1097	    if ($script:dtUpdated -gt 0)   { $parts += "$($script:dtUpdated) updated" }
1098	    if ($script:dtAccepted -gt 0)  { $parts += "$($script:dtAccepted) accepted" }
1099	    if ($script:dtVerified -gt 0)  { $parts += "$($script:dtVerified) verified" }
1100	    $text = if ($parts.Count -gt 0) { $parts -join ", " } else { "verified" }
1101	    $script:deployTrackerText = $text
1102	
1103	    if ($script:dtSkipped -gt 0) {
1104	        Write-Summary "WARN" $ToolName "$($script:dtSkipped) skipped (user review)"
1105	    } else {
1106	        Write-Summary "OK" $ToolName $text
1107	    }
1108	}

1111	# PATH helpers

1113	
1114	# Refresh-Path: Merge registry PATH entries into current PATH (additive).
1115	# Preserves runtime additions from Ensure-ToolOnPath and entries inherited
1116	# from the parent process (e.g., Git Bash usr/bin). Only ADDS directories
1117	# found in registry but missing from current PATH.
1118	# Call after winget install/upgrade to pick up PATH changes in same session.
1119	function Refresh-Path {
1120	    $registryPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "Machine") + ";" +
1121	                    [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User")
1122	    $currentDirs = ($env:Path -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ }
1123	    $currentSet = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new(
1124	        [string[]]$currentDirs, [System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
1125	    $newDirs = ($registryPath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -and -not $currentSet.Contains($_) }
1126	    if ($newDirs) {
1127	        $env:Path = $env:Path + ";" + ($newDirs -join ';')
1128	    }
1129	}

1137	# Log-WingetOutput: Filter and log captured winget command output.
1138	# Strips spinner characters (- \ | /), download progress bars (KB/MB/GB),
1139	# and empty lines. Remaining lines are logged at info level.
1140	function Log-WingetOutput([string]$Output) {
1141	    $Output.Trim().Split("`n") | ForEach-Object {
1142	        $l = $_.TrimEnd()
1143	        if ($l.Trim() -and $l.Trim() -notmatch '^[-\\|/]+$' -and $l -notmatch '\d+(\.\d+)?\s*(KB|MB|GB)\s*/\s*\d+') {
1144	            Log $l
1145	        }
1146	    }
1147	}

1149	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1150	# Repair broken uv tool environment (cross-platform)
1151	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1152	# When `uv tool upgrade <tool>` fails with "missing a valid environment",
1153	# find a working Python via `uv python find` (fallback: system python/python3)
1154	# and reinstall with --force --python <path>.
1155	# Returns $true if repaired, $false if not applicable or failed.
1156	function Repair-UvToolEnv {
1157	    param(
1158	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ToolName,
1159	        [string]$UpgradeOutput = ""
1160	    )
1161	
1162	    if ($UpgradeOutput -notmatch 'missing a valid environment') { return $false }
1163	
1164	    LogWarn "$ToolName uv environment is broken (Python removed?) -- repairing..."
1165	
1166	    # Find a working Python -- uv's own Pythons first, then system
1167	    # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with fallback chain
1168	    $workingPython = $null
1169	    $uvPython = & uv python find 2>$null
1170	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $uvPython -and (Test-Path $uvPython)) {
1171	        $workingPython = $uvPython
1172	    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
1173	        $workingPython = (Get-Command python).Source
1174	    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
1175	        $workingPython = (Get-Command python3).Source
1176	    }
1177	
1178	    if (-not $workingPython) {
1179	        LogError "Cannot repair $ToolName -- no working Python found"
1180	        return $false
1181	    }
1182	
1183	    Log "Repairing with: uv tool install --force --python $workingPython $ToolName"
1184	    $repairOutput = & uv tool install --force --python $workingPython $ToolName 2>&1 | Out-String
1185	    $repairOutput.Trim().Split("`n") | ForEach-Object {
1186	        $l = $_.TrimEnd(); if ($l.Trim()) { Log $l }
1187	    }
1188	
1189	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
1190	        LogError "$ToolName environment repair failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)"
1191	        return $false
1192	    }
1193	
1194	    LogOk "Repaired $ToolName uv environment"
1195	    return $true
1196	}

1199	# Remove orphaned Python directories (Windows only)
1200	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1201	# Scans %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\ for PythonXYZ\ directories where
1202	# python.exe is gone (uninstalled). Removes the orphaned directory tree and
1203	# cleans stale entries from User PATH.
1204	# Returns count of directories removed (0 = nothing to clean).
1205	function Remove-OrphanedPythonDirs {
1206	    if (-not $IsWindows) { return 0 }
1207	
1208	    $pythonBase = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Programs\Python"
1209	    if (-not (Test-Path $pythonBase)) { return 0 }
1210	
1211	    $removedCount = 0

1213	    if (-not $candidates) { return 0 }
1214	
1215	    foreach ($dir in $candidates) {

1217	        if ($dir.Name -eq "Launcher") { continue }
1218	
1219	        # Orphaned = python.exe is gone
1220	        $pythonExe = Join-Path $dir.FullName "python.exe"
1221	        if (Test-Path $pythonExe) { continue }
1222	
1223	        # Log stale executables for visibility
1224	        $scriptsDir = Join-Path $dir.FullName "Scripts"
1225	        if (Test-Path $scriptsDir) {
1226	            $staleExes = Get-ChildItem $scriptsDir -Filter "*.exe" -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1227	            if ($staleExes) {
1228	                $names = ($staleExes | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ", "
1229	                LogWarn "Orphaned Python dir with stale executables: $($dir.Name) ($names)"
1230	            }
1231	        }
1232	
1233	        try {
1234	            Remove-Item -Path $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
1235	            LogOk "Removed orphaned directory: $($dir.FullName)"
1236	            $removedCount++
1237	        } catch {
1238	            LogError "Failed to remove $($dir.FullName): $_"
1239	        }
1240	    }
1241	
1242	    # Clean stale User PATH entries pointing to removed Python dirs
1243	    if ($removedCount -gt 0) {
1244	        $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User")
1245	        if ($userPath) {
1246	            $entries = $userPath -split ";"
1247	            $cleanEntries = @()
1248	            $removedEntries = @()
1249	
1250	            foreach ($entry in $entries) {
1251	                $trimmed = $entry.TrimEnd("\", "/")
1252	                if ($trimmed -match '\\Programs\\Python\\Python\d+' -and -not (Test-Path $trimmed)) {
1253	                    $removedEntries += $trimmed
1254	                } else {
1255	                    $cleanEntries += $entry

1274	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1275	# PS 5.1 compatibility: ConvertFrom-Json -> Hashtable (recursive, array-aware)
1276	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1277	function ConvertPSObjectToHashtable($obj) {
1278	    if ($null -eq $obj) { return @{} }
1279	    if ($obj -is [array]) {
1280	        return ,@($obj | ForEach-Object { ConvertPSObjectToHashtable $_ })
1281	    }
1282	    if ($obj -isnot [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) { return $obj }
1283	    $ht = @{}
1284	    foreach ($prop in $obj.PSObject.Properties) {
1285	        $ht[$prop.Name] = ConvertPSObjectToHashtable $prop.Value
1286	    }
1287	    return $ht
1288	}

1305	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1306	# JSON normalization for comparison (sorted keys, deterministic output)
1307	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1308	# PowerShell hashtable key ordering is non-deterministic. ConvertTo-Json
1309	# produces different strings for semantically identical objects, causing
1310	# false-positive change detection. These functions recursively sort keys
1311	# before serializing, ensuring identical content produces identical JSON.
1312	#
1313	# Usage:
1314	#   $norm = Normalize-JsonForComparison $hashtable
1315	#   $norm = Normalize-JsonForComparison $hashtable -Depth 5 -Compress
1316	function ConvertTo-CanonicalObject($obj) {
1317	    if ($null -eq $obj) { return $null }
1318	    if ($obj -is [array]) {
1319	        return ,@($obj | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-CanonicalObject $_ })
1320	    }
1321	    if ($obj -is [hashtable]) {
1322	        $ordered = [ordered]@{}
1323	        foreach ($key in ($obj.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
1324	            $ordered[$key] = ConvertTo-CanonicalObject $obj[$key]
1325	        }
1326	        return [PSCustomObject]$ordered
1327	    }
1328	    if ($obj -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) {
1329	        $ordered = [ordered]@{}
1330	        foreach ($prop in ($obj.PSObject.Properties | Sort-Object Name)) {
1331	            $ordered[$prop.Name] = ConvertTo-CanonicalObject $prop.Value
1332	        }
1333	        return [PSCustomObject]$ordered
1334	    }
1335	    return $obj
1336	}
1337	
1338	function Normalize-JsonForComparison {
1339	    param($Value, [int]$Depth = 10, [switch]$Compress)
1340	    if ($null -eq $Value) { return "null" }
1341	    $canonical = ConvertTo-CanonicalObject $Value
1342	    $canonical | ConvertTo-Json -Depth $Depth -Compress:$Compress
1343	}

1345	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1346	# Go install provenance detection (Windows)
1347	# Returns: "winget", "chocolatey", "scoop", "msi", "none", or "unknown"
1348	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1349	function Get-GoProvenance {
1350	    # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback
1351	    $goCmd = Get-Command go -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1352	    if (-not $goCmd) { return "none" }
1353	    $goSource = $goCmd.Source
1354	    if ($goSource -like '*\Program Files\Go\*') {
1355	        $wingetCheck = winget list --id GoLang.Go --accept-source-agreements 2>&1 | Out-String
1356	        if ($wingetCheck -match 'GoLang\.Go') { return "winget" }
1357	        return "msi"
1358	    }
1359	    if ($goSource -like '*\chocolatey\*') { return "chocolatey" }
1360	    if ($goSource -like '*\scoop\*') { return "scoop" }
1361	    return "unknown"
1362	}

1364	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1365	# Ensure GOPATH\bin is on persistent User PATH (Windows)
1366	# Returns $true if already present, $false if added
1367	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1368	function Ensure-GopathBinOnPath {
1369	    $gopath = $env:GOPATH
1370	    if (-not $gopath) { $gopath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "go" }
1371	    $gopathBin = Join-Path $gopath "bin"
1372	    $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User")
1373	    if ($userPath -like "*$gopathBin*") { return $true }
1374	    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "$userPath;$gopathBin", "User")
1375	    Refresh-Path
1376	    return $false
1377	}

1380	# Summary panel renderer
1381	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1382	# Reads AITOOLS_SUMMARY_FILE, displays colored panel, cleans up.
1383	# Silent no-op if file unset, missing, or empty.
1384	function Show-Summary {
1385	    $sfile = $env:AITOOLS_SUMMARY_FILE
1386	    if (-not $sfile -or -not (Test-Path $sfile)) { return }
1387	    # Read summary file; -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue checked on next line
1388	    $lines = Get-Content $sfile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1389	    if (-not $lines) {
1390	        # Summary file empty or unreadable; clean up and return
1391	        try { Remove-Item $sfile -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
1392	        catch { Write-Host "  note: could not remove empty summary file" -ForegroundColor Gray }
1393	        return
1394	    }
1395	
1396	    # Dedup by tool name: highest severity wins (ERROR > WARN > OK).
1397	    # ACTIONs (empty tool name) are never deduped. DETAIL lines collected separately.
1398	    $rank = @{ 'OK' = 1; 'WARN' = 2; 'ERROR' = 3 }
1399	    $order = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1400	    $best = @{}
1401	    $bestDetail = @{}
1402	    $detailMap = @{}
1403	    $actions = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1404	
1405	    foreach ($line in $lines) {
1406	        $parts = $line -split '\|', 3
1407	        $cat = $parts[0]
1408	        $tool = $parts[1]
1409	        $det = $parts[2]
1410	        if ($cat -eq 'DETAIL') {
1411	            if (-not $detailMap.ContainsKey($tool)) { $detailMap[$tool] = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new() }
1412	            $detailMap[$tool].Add($det)
1413	            continue
1414	        }
1415	        if ($cat -eq 'ACTION' -or $tool -eq '') {
1416	            $actions.Add($line)
1417	            continue
1418	        }
1419	        $r = if ($rank.ContainsKey($cat)) { $rank[$cat] } else { 0 }
1420	        if (-not $best.ContainsKey($tool)) {
1421	            $order.Add($tool)
1422	            $best[$tool] = $cat
1423	            $bestDetail[$tool] = $det
1424	        } elseif ($r -gt $rank[$best[$tool]]) {
1425	            $best[$tool] = $cat
1426	            $bestDetail[$tool] = $det
1427	        }
1428	    }
1429	
1430	    # Build deduped lines, pre-sorted: OK+details, WARN+details, ERROR+details, ACTIONs
1431	    $deduped = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
1432	    foreach ($sev in @('OK', 'WARN', 'ERROR')) {
1433	        foreach ($t in $order) {
1434	            if ($best[$t] -ne $sev) { continue }
1435	            $deduped.Add("$sev|$t|$($bestDetail[$t])")
1436	            if ($detailMap.ContainsKey($t)) {
1437	                foreach ($d in $detailMap[$t]) { $deduped.Add("DETAIL|$t|$d") }
1438	            }
1439	        }
1440	    }
1441	    foreach ($a in $actions) { $deduped.Add($a) }
1442	
1443	    # Color and tag maps for severity categories
1444	    $colorMap = @{ 'OK' = 'Green'; 'WARN' = 'Yellow'; 'ERROR' = 'Red' }
1445	    $tagMap = @{ 'OK' = '  [ok]  '; 'WARN' = '  [!]   '; 'ERROR' = '  [ERR] ' }
1446	
1447	    # Single-pass display: deduped list is pre-sorted by severity.
1448	    # DETAIL lines inherit the color of their preceding parent entry.
1449	    Write-Host ""
1450	    Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------"
1451	    $lastColor = 'Green'
1452	    $firstAction = $true
1453	    foreach ($line in $deduped) {
1454	        $parts = $line -split '\|', 3
1455	        $cat = $parts[0]
1456	        if ($cat -eq 'DETAIL') {
1457	            Write-Host ("                          {0}" -f $parts[2]) -ForegroundColor $lastColor
1458	            continue
1459	        }
1460	        if ($colorMap.ContainsKey($cat)) {
1461	            $lastColor = $colorMap[$cat]
1462	            Write-Host ("{0}{1,-16} {2}" -f $tagMap[$cat], $parts[1], $parts[2]) -ForegroundColor $lastColor
1463	            continue
1464	        }
1465	        if ($cat -eq 'ACTION') {
1466	            if ($firstAction) {
1467	                Write-Host ""
1468	                Write-Host "  ACTION REQUIRED -- run before tools are ready:" -ForegroundColor Magenta
1469	                $firstAction = $false
1470	            }
1471	            Write-Host "  >>  $($parts[2])" -ForegroundColor Magenta
1472	        }
1473	    }
1474	    Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------"
1475	
1476	    # Preserve summary for log compliance checks
1477	    if ($env:AITOOLS_PRESERVE_SUMMARY -eq "1") {
1478	        $preserveDest = Join-Path $script:logDir "last-summary.txt"
1479	        try { Copy-Item $sfile $preserveDest -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
1480	        catch {
1481	            # Non-blocking: summary already displayed; preservation is for compliance checks
1482	            Write-Host "  warning: could not preserve summary: $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow
1483	        }
1484	    }
1485	    # Summary file cleanup (already displayed; next run creates a fresh one)
1486	    try { Remove-Item $sfile -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
1487	    catch { Write-Host "  note: could not remove summary file" -ForegroundColor Gray }
1488	}
1489	
1490	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1491	# Build prerequisite checking
1492	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1493	
1494	# Known build prerequisites by ecosystem.
1495	# To add a new prerequisite: add an entry to the appropriate ecosystem array.
1496	# Fields: Name (display), Check (scriptblock), Install (remediation), Platform (win/mac/all)
1497	$script:BuildPrereqs = @{
1498	    "cargo" = @(
1499	        @{
1500	            Name    = "MSVC Build Tools"
1501	            Check   = {
1502	                $vsWhere = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
1503	                if (Test-Path $vsWhere) {
1504	                    $installs = & $vsWhere -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath 2>$null
1505	                    return [bool]$installs
1506	                }
1507	                return $false
1508	            }
1509	            Install = "winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools (add 'Desktop Development with C++' workload)"
1510	            Platform = "win"
1511	        },
1512	        @{
1513	            Name       = "NASM"
1514	            ToolName   = "nasm"
1515	            # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback
1516	            Check      = { [bool](Get-Command nasm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
1517	            # Verified: 2026-03-11 (winget NASM.NASM v3.01, per-user Nullsoft installer)
1518	            KnownPaths = @("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\bin\NASM\nasm.exe", "$env:ProgramFiles\NASM\nasm.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\NASM\nasm.exe")
1519	            Install    = "winget install NASM.NASM"
1520	            Platform   = "win"
1521	        },
1522	        @{
1523	            Name       = "CMake"
1524	            ToolName   = "cmake"
1525	            # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback
1526	            Check      = { [bool](Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
1527	            # Official: cmake.org/download lists pip, ZIP, MSI (not winget)
1528	            # PyPI: cmake 4.2.3, maintained by Kitware (jcfr@kitware.com)
1529	            # Source: https://cmake.org/download/ + https://pypi.org/project/cmake/
1530	            # Verified source: 2026-03-12 via chrome-devtools
1531	            KnownPaths = @(
1532	                "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin\cmake.exe",       # Verified: 2026-03-12 (v4.2.3, uv tool install)
1533	                "$env:APPDATA\Python\Scripts\cmake.exe",       # UNVERIFIED: pip install --user
1534	                "$env:ProgramFiles\CMake\bin\cmake.exe"        # UNVERIFIED: MSI fallback
1535	            )
1536	            Install    = "uv tool install cmake"
1537	            Platform   = "win"
1538	        }
1539	    )
1540	}
1541	
1542	# Ensure-ToolOnPath: Verify a tool is findable after installation.
1543	# Tries: 1) Get-Command (current PATH), 2) Refresh-Path (registry reload),
1544	# 3) KnownPaths fallback (filesystem check + session PATH update).
1545	# Returns $true if tool is now on PATH, $false otherwise.
1546	# Callers: setup scripts after winget install, Check-BuildPrereqs fallback.
1547	function Ensure-ToolOnPath {
1548	    param(
1549	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ToolName,
1550	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]]$KnownPaths
1551	    )
1552	    # Get-Command exempt: command-existence check with explicit fallback
1553	    if (Get-Command $ToolName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { return $true }
1554	
1555	    # Reload PATH from registry (picks up changes from winget installers)
1556	    Refresh-Path
1557	    if (Get-Command $ToolName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { return $true }
1558	
1559	    # Fallback: check known install locations on disk
1560	    foreach ($kp in $KnownPaths) {
1561	        if (Test-Path $kp) {
1562	            $parentDir = Split-Path $kp -Parent
1563	            $env:Path = "$parentDir;$env:Path"
1564	            Log "$ToolName found at $kp (added to session PATH)"
1565	            return $true
1566	        }
1567	    }
1568	    return $false
1569	}
1570	
1571	function Check-BuildPrereqs {
1572	    <#
1573	    .SYNOPSIS
1574	    Checks known build prerequisites for an ecosystem (cargo, pip, go).
1575	    Returns array of missing prerequisites. Empty array = all present.
1576	    Callers decide whether to abort or warn.
1577	
1578	    Detection order per prerequisite:
1579	    1. Run the Check scriptblock (typically Get-Command / PATH-based)
1580	    2. If Check fails AND entry has KnownPaths + ToolName, call Ensure-ToolOnPath
1581	       which tries Refresh-Path then filesystem fallback
1582	    3. If still not found, add to missing array
1583	    #>
1584	    param(
1585	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Ecosystem
1586	    )
1587	
1588	    $prereqs = $script:BuildPrereqs[$Ecosystem]
1589	    if (-not $prereqs) { return @() }
1590	
1591	    $missing = @()
1592	    foreach ($p in $prereqs) {
1593	        # Filter by platform
1594	        if ($p.Platform -eq "win" -and -not $IsWindows) { continue }
1595	        if ($p.Platform -eq "mac" -and $IsWindows) { continue }
1596	
1597	        $present = & $p.Check
1598	        if (-not $present -and $p.KnownPaths -and $p.ToolName) {
1599	            $present = Ensure-ToolOnPath -ToolName $p.ToolName -KnownPaths $p.KnownPaths
1600	        }
1601	        if (-not $present) {
1602	            $missing += $p
1603	        }
1604	    }
1605	    return $missing
1606	}
1607	
1608	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1609	# Build failure diagnosis
1610	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1611	
1612	# Known build failure signatures.
1613	# To add a new signature: add an entry to this array.
1614	# When a user reports a new build failure, add the error pattern + remedy here.
1615	$script:BuildFailureSignatures = @(
1616	    @{ Pattern = "NASM command not found";                Remedy = "winget install NASM.NASM";                     Name = "NASM (assembler)" }
1617	    @{ Pattern = "linker.*not found|link\.exe.*not found"; Remedy = "Install MSVC Build Tools with C++ workload";  Name = "MSVC linker" }
1618	    @{ Pattern = "cmake.*not found|Could not find cmake"; Remedy = "uv tool install cmake (or see cmake.org/download)"; Name = "CMake" }
1619	    @{ Pattern = "pkg-config.*not found";                 Remedy = "Install pkg-config";                           Name = "pkg-config" }
1620	    @{ Pattern = "Python\.h.*not found|python.*dev";      Remedy = "Install Python development headers";           Name = "Python headers" }
1621	    @{ Pattern = "C compiler.*not found|cc.*not found";   Remedy = "Install a C compiler (MSVC/gcc/clang)";        Name = "C compiler" }
1622	    @{ Pattern = "openssl.*not found|OPENSSL_DIR";        Remedy = "Install OpenSSL or set OPENSSL_DIR";           Name = "OpenSSL" }
1623	)
1624	
1625	function Diagnose-BuildFailure {
1626	    <#
1627	    .SYNOPSIS
1628	    Scans build output for known failure signatures and returns actionable remediation.
1629	    Call this after a build command fails to surface the real cause.
1630	    Returns $null if no known signature matches (generic failure).
1631	    #>
1632	    param(
1633	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Output
1634	    )
1635	
1636	    foreach ($sig in $script:BuildFailureSignatures) {
1637	        if ($Output -match $sig.Pattern) {
1638	            return $sig
1639	        }
1640	    }
1641	    return $null
1642	}

1	# aitools Release Notes
2	
3	## Versioning
4	
5	`major.minor.patch` -- not semver (no API contract), but follows the same spirit:
6	
7	- **Major** (v0 → v1): structural changes to CLI commands, architecture, or project layout
8	- **Minor** (v0.14): new features, new managed tools, batches of improvements
9	- **Patch** (v0.14.1): isolated bug fixes with no new functionality
10	
11	Multiple changes on the same day roll into one release. Bug fixes ship alongside features in the same minor if they land together.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## v0.69.0 -- Remote bootstrap one-liner + uv-unified Python + per-user deploy + registry consolidation (2026-06-15)
16	
17	### New features
18	
19	| # | Change |
20	|---|--------|
21	| 1 | **Remote bootstrap one-liner** (fa07e52, 7cc8cb5) — `scripts/bootstrap.{sh,ps1}`: `curl\|bash` (macOS/Linux) / `irm\|iex` (Windows) installs prerequisites (package manager + git), clones nobul-tech/aitools, runs the installer, then (interactive) pulls the dotprofile and rebuilds from it. README documents both one-liners. |
22	| 2 | **uv as the unified Python manager** (2e702a9 macOS, 3c4bba4 Windows) — `setup-python.{sh,ps1}` run `uv python install <ver> --default` so `python`/`python3` resolve to the uv-managed interpreter (`~/.local/bin` shims); per-repo override via uv `.python-version` / `uv venv`. Replaces brew-python (macOS) and pymanager (Windows). Installer reordered: uv (Step 14) before Python (Step 15). |
23	| 3 | **Per-user MDM deploy** (2c0fd32) — `build-deploy.sh` builds the personalized self-contained `deploy/` into the user's dotprofile repo (`aitools-<ghuser>/deploy/`), not the shared `aitools/deploy/`. Skips gracefully when no dotprofile is configured. |
24	| 4 | **Registries consolidated under `registries/`** — the JSON registries (tool-registry, tool-ops, tool-versions, framework-registry, glossary, incidents) are now canonical in `registries/`; the duplicate `reference/*.json` copies were removed. Skills (`/tool-registry`, `/tool-ops`), `sources-of-truth.md`, framework docs, and `check-post-push` repointed to `registries/`; `check-pre-commit` step 16 audit extended to also guard `registries/`. `glossary.json` reconciled (newer `reference/` content promoted into `registries/`). |

27	
28	| # | Severity | Change |
29	|---|----------|--------|
30	| 1 | High | **bash 3.2 install crash** (fa07e52) — empty `sync_args` array under `set -u` aborted Step 22 on a fresh Mac. Guarded with `${arr[@]+...}`. |
31	| 2 | High | **`set -e` abort pre-user-init** (fa07e52) — `VAR=$(read_config_key … userRepoPath)` returned nonzero when the key was absent, killing aitools-install (402/408), build-deploy (1011), setup-user-skills, setup-user-hooks. Guarded `\|\| true` → graceful shared-only fallback. |
32	| 3 | Medium | **Homebrew not on PATH non-interactively** (2c0fd32) — `aitools` + `aitools-install` eval `brew shellenv` on macOS when brew is absent from PATH; fixes "node required for JSON manipulation" under hooks/MDM/`!`-shells. |
33	| 4 | Medium | **Modal spurious "Python 3.10+ required"** (2e702a9) — setup-modal skips the system-python gate when uv is present (uv provisions its own Python); enforces 3.10+ only on the pip fallback. |
34	| 5 | Low | **Cursor CLI drift** (fa07e52) — `agent mcp disable` removed upstream; setup-cursor-ide-mcp uses `agent mcp remove`, non-fatal. |
35	| 6 | Low | **bootstrap flow ordering** (7cc8cb5) — deployed shared-only configs before pulling the dotprofile; reordered so `user init` pulls it, then `aitools` rebuilds from it. |

## Summary

Phase 5 of the harvest/archive/logging plan (`plans/imperative-gliding-newell.md` §14/§20) was intentionally deferred at a clean checkpoint. The highest-blast-radius logging change — migrating `aitools-lib.{sh,ps1}` to the unified `~/.aitools/logs/` location with rotation — was left for a focused session that can also verify on macOS. Everything else in Phases 1–4 shipped and is fully working; the new `ait-harvest.py` logs correctly via its own `RotatingFileHandler` regardless.

Filed so the remaining work is tracked rather than living only in a session scratch doc.

## Remaining work

- [ ] **`aitools-lib.sh` / `aitools-lib.ps1` logging migration** — `AITOOLS_LOG_DIR` → `~/.aitools/logs`, per-component `LOG_FILE` naming via `logging_init`/`Initialize-Logging` arg, size-based rotation (5 MB × 5) in bash + PS1. Touches every setup script and the inlined `deploy/` copies. **Verify on macOS** (the location override reverses a deliberate 3-way native-dir decision, RELEASE_NOTES L865).
- [ ] **Old log-path literal cleanup** (plan §20.3 M4) — `grep -rn` for `.local/state`, `Library/Logs`, `LOCALAPPDATA`, `deploy.log` across `scripts/`, `shared/`, `reference/`, checks; migrate each. Known sites: `aitools`, `aitools.ps1`, `aitools-lib.sh`, `aitools-lib.ps1`, `check-lib.ps1`, `check-prereq-detection.ps1`, `setup-bash.ps1`, `setup-rust.ps1`, `setup-python.ps1`.
- [ ] **Doc consolidation** — `reference/logging.md` is created; trim the four scattered logging docs (script-standards.md, script-standards-detail.md, cross-platform.md, hook-rollout.md) to directive + pointer (plan §14.2). Add catch-up + subagents + helper + `logs/` to `reference/user-repo.md`, `reference/tool-ops-claude-code.md`, `.claude/rules/artifact-harvesting.md`, `.claude/rules/aitools-workspace.md`.
- [ ] **Hooks-manifest as the generator** (plan §5 full vision) — `hooks-manifest.json` is currently the AUDIT source (`check-post-push` step 32, which already prevents bash↔PS1 drift). Make `setup-user-hooks.{sh,ps1}` + `build-deploy.sh` *generate* registrations from the manifest at build time (the deeper refactor that fully removes the parallel hand-maintained lists).
- [ ] After the above: re-run `build-deploy.sh`, `check-post-push` (step 32 must pass), verify on macOS, then RELEASE_NOTES entry + version tag.

## Context

Phases 1–4 (Windows RCA fix, `ait-harvest.py` helper with the concurrency redesign, harvest reconcile, single-source parity audit) are complete and committed; 14/14 unit tests pass. See `plans/imperative-gliding-newell.md` §20 and `.scratch/session-8f1728f5/PROTECTED-CHANGES-FOR-REVIEW.md`.

"Remote bootstrap one-liner + uv-unified Python + per-user deploy + registry consolidation." Headlines:

- **Per-user MDM deploy** — `build-deploy.sh` targets the dotprofile repo's `deploy/`, not shared `aitools/deploy/` (which is now frozen).
- **Registries consolidated** to `registries/`; duplicate `reference/*.json` removed.
